pup.css: .c-pup .ball,.c-pup>path{fill:url(#pup-ball)!important}.c-pup .tail,.c-pup .tongue,.c-pup .head-g,.c-pup .paw-l,.c-pup .paw-r{transform-box:fill-box}.c-pup .tail{transform-origin:15% 80%}.c-pup .tongue{transform-origin:50% 10%;opacity:0}.c-pup .head-g{transform-origin:50% 55%}.c-pup .paw-l{transform-origin:25% 30%}.c-pup .paw-r{transform-origin:75% 30%}.c-pup.s-work .tail{animation:ppWag 1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-work .tongue{opacity:1;animation:ppPant 1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-read .head-g{animation:ppTilt 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-happy .paw-l{animation:ppWaveL 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-happy .paw-r{animation:ppWaveR 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-pup.s-happy .tail{animation:ppWag 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes ppWag{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)}25%{transform:rotate(-18deg)}75%{transform:rotate(16deg)}}@keyframes ppPant{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(1)}50%{transform:translateY(4px) scaleY(1.18)}}@keyframes ppTilt{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:rotate(8deg) translateY(2px)}}@keyframes ppWaveL{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(-22deg)}}@keyframes ppWaveR{0%,100%{transform:translateY(-14px) rotate(20deg)}50%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}}

notes: Each character uses a radial gradient on the silhouette ball with a rich, dark center behind the shared white eyes so they read clearly while transitioning smoothly into dimensional, multi-stop shaded forms and rim highlights. Layered front and back groups keep the eye zone unobstructed above y = 30 and drive responsive 1-2.4s CSS transform and opacity loops for working, reading, and pleased states.
